findings.evidence: Repository-wide rg finds no corresponding characteristic lemmas; lines 176–178 and 473–475 already unfold SupportedIn.homComplexificationEquiv. The existing CompactSupport/Complexification.lean API provides CLE forward/inverse bridge lemmas at lines 321–338 and 376–391.
findings.fix: Add forward/inverse application formulas for the supported and product equivalences, bridge lemmas from both CLEs to their algebraic equivalences, and inverse fibrewise formulas for compact and native tests.
findings.issue: The characteristic API is incomplete for SupportedIn.homComplexificationEquiv, CompactlySupported.homComplexificationEquivProd, both stage/compact homComplexificationCLE definitions, and the compact/native inverse maps.

findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 673 and 682 have no attributes, whereas the parallel section evaluation and support formulas at lines 108–120 and 124–128 are marked @[simp].
findings.issue: BundleTest.homComplexificationCLE_apply and homComplexificationCLE_closedSupport lack @[simp], so simplification does not perform the native coefficient evaluation or support normalization.

summary: Several public equivalences lack characteristic application lemmas, forcing consumers to unfold their implementations. The native test equivalence also omits simplifier annotations on its characteristic formulas.
